trade_off_notice: Mesh Option: MEDIUM (25.0m x 25.0m). SCIENTIFIC NOTICE: A finer mesh increases spatial discretization detail but does NOT automatically guarantee higher hydraulic accuracy. Finer grids require smaller computational timesteps under CFL stability rules, increase CPU runtime significantly, and can amplify localized numerical dispersion if bed roughness and topography gradients are under-resolved.
